sections.Profile:
Mystic Star, released by Zaccaria in 1986, is a solid-state pinball machine with a wizard and magic theme. It was distributed as a conversion kit, shipped as a complete game minus the circuit boards, and utilized the Bally MPU AS-2518-35 board set. The following year, Tecnoplay, a subsidiary of Zaccaria, re-released this game as Devil King, maintaining the same gameplay elements but featuring updated artwork and branding.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1986–1987
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Wizards, Mystical, Dual Theme, Original Theme, Solid State, Fantasy, 1980s
